lookup_code_to_language: lookup a language code in CODE_TO_LANGUAGE to get the full language name
lookup_language_to_code: lookup a language name in LANGUAGE_TO_CODE to get its ISO 639 code
build_language_mapping: build a bidirectional mapping between ISO language codes and full language names
summarize_language_codes: summarize the supported language codes in CODE_TO_LANGUAGE for OCR recognition
test_language_mappings: test the bidirectional CODE_TO_LANGUAGE and LANGUAGE_TO_CODE mappings for consistency
